items.title: Priority Projects now in public beta
items.summary: are now in public beta for Pro and Enterprise teams. This optional upgrade for individual Vercel projects adds bot and traffic-source signals, Page Integrity for monitoring and controlling client-side scripts and connections, and additional Firewall controls and alerts.Priority Projects is free on all plans. You can enable it to challenge non-browser traffic while allowing verified bots. Priority adds more detailed bot signals: categories, verification status, and names where available. Use these signals in:Bot protectionPriority adds Traffic Sources labels for requests from Tor exit nodes, VPNs, open or anonymizing proxies, and residential proxies. It also labels traffic flagged by abuse blocklists.Use these labels in custom Firewall rules, analyze them in Firewall Observability, or read them from the  request header in your application. A request can have multiple labels.x-vercel-waf-sourceUse the Traffic Sources managed ruleset to log, challenge, or block traffic by source category. Review matching traffic before enabling blocking, since these categories can also include legitimate users.To enable the Traffic Sources managed ruleset from the CLI, run .
